title: coelogyne talangana
intro: Coelogyne talangana, commonly known as the 'Talang Anna's Coelogyne', is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Malaysia and Indonesia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Coelogyne talangana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Coelogyne talangana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
